name: Do you offer removal of old crown molding before installing new molding?

mainEntity.name: Do you offer removal of old crown molding before installing new molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, as part of our comprehensive service, we can professionally remove existing crown molding. This process involves carefully detaching the old molding, minimizing damage to your walls and ceiling. After removal, we prepare the surfaces to ensure they are smooth and ready for the new installation. This integrated approach ensures a clean transition and a high-quality finish for your updated crown molding project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we offer professional removal of existing crown molding and surface preparation before new installation.
